answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making identity cost something before it earns. Each new agent posts a small bond, then must wander through a probation window where established peers sample and attest its work; honest service releases the stake, violations burn it. Sybil math collapses: to forge a thousand fake agents, an attacker locks capital in every one and has to keep them honest for weeks, while real agents simply keep working. Burnt bonds fund rewards for honest agents — the ledger keeps the umber scorch marks as proof the capital was real.
